attrs.evidence: This is the half GPT-5.6 called 'especially strong' in its audit and then left out of its own Phase 1 — which would have shipped a vocabulary of labels with nothing enforcing them. A taxonomy without a consumption relation is a comment, and this project has already paid the exact price: C10 declared an IMMUTABLE cap in a comment and returned a plain mutable object. The relation is enforced claim by claim by scripts/check-mosaic.mjs and NEGATIVE-TESTED against three historical errors it must refuse — model concurrence consumed as theorem evidence, a 2,000-trial property test consumed as a universal, and a bounded exhaustion consumed as universal absence. ITS FIRST RUN REFUTED A SHIPPED PROVED CLAIM: see LED-C9.
attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6 (Mosaic audit §9) proposed the relation; scoping it into Phase 1 and enforcing it is this round's.
attrs.review_focus: The status -> obligation mapping is a judgement call in one place: exhaustion may discharge universal_affirmation when its space IS the domain (REPRO-CLOSURE) and may not when its space is a sample (a property test). That distinction is carried by a prose `space_bound` field, which a reviewer must read. It is not itself checkable.
attrs.statement: An evidence kind may only discharge the obligations the consumption relation allows it, and a claim whose status demands an obligation its declared kind cannot discharge is REFUSED by the gate.
